messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — we're drafting a private-offer play that bundles Redwood hosted + partner hardware credits + SI integration hours. Goal: clear SKU + renewal mechanics by EOW for marketplace listing. Ideas?
Samir Chen: Love it. My initial thought: create 3 commit tiers (50k, 200k, 500k) with discrete discount & SI-credit bands. hardware voucher reduces invoice, SI credit applied as onboarding credit. Keep public listing minimal.
Rohit Kapoor: Heads up — some cloud marketplaces forbid listing partner voucher details in the offer text. We should map to two SKUs: `redwood.core` and `redwood.bundle.partnerHW_v1` (internal only). External listing references only `redwood.bundle` generic SKU.
Elaine Wu: Legal note: do not promise co-sell revenue share on the marketplace listing. Any partner rev-share or referral fee must be governed in the partner contract, not in the public offer. Need NDAs/partner addendum templates for SI credits.
Jordan Lee: Finance flags: marketplace take rates vary (7-15%). For a 200k commit — build in a buffer so our net effective discount to customer doesn't blow margin. Also define ARR recognition path for hardware vouchers vs consumption credits.
Tim O'Connor: Implementation note from SE side: redemption should be metered. Customers use voucher code in console; SI credits consumed as hours against `si:onboarding` usage line. Suggest redemption mechanics: code -> unlock SKU components -> allocate credits. Example mapping (internal):
```
SKU: RW-MKT-BDL-HW-200
components: ["hosted-api:200k_tokens", "si-credit:40h", "hw-voucher:$20k"]
commit: 200000
discount_display: 18%  # internal calc after marketplace fees
redemption: single-use code via portal
```
Rohit Kapoor: Also consider renewal cadence: standardize on 12/24/36 month terms with step-down discounts on renew (e.g., -2% each consecutive renewal if commit increases). That keeps customers engaged and gives predictable runway for Dedicated capacity planning.
Samir Chen: For SIs, offer two incentive paths: (1) deal registration + one-time onboarding credit (higher) or (2) ongoing referral (lower). Simpler to operate is one-time credits tied to commit milestone.
Elaine Wu: Add: ensure partner credit terms expire within contract window (e.g., use within 90 days) to avoid long tail liabilities. We'll add clauses for clawback if commit not met.
Jordan Lee: Action item: run a P&L sensitivity for 50/200/500k commits including marketplace fees, partner credits, and assumed uplift. I can own this if Rohit provides model assumptions by tomorrow.
Maya Patel: Solid. Next steps: Rohit -> produce SKU mapping + renewal table. Jordan -> P&L sensitivity. Elaine -> draft partner addendum with credit & clawback language. Tim -> prototype redemption flow and sample portal UX. I'll create a GH issue and paste link here. :thumbsup:
deals-bot: Reminder created: PRJ-6426 "marketplace bundle SKU + SI/hw credits" assigned to Maya Patel, due 2025-05-09.
Maya Patel: Thanks all — will sync after GH issue comments. If any blocker on legal language ping Elaine directly. :sparkles:
